methods.name: init
methods.desc:
`weightListLength` is ignored. It used to reserve that many full weights boxes, which capped the
raffle at `weightListLength * ChunkSize` entrants and locked their storage up front. Weights
storage now grows with the entries, each entry paying for its own (`EntryWeightMBR`). The
argument stays so callers of the earlier ABI keep working.

methods.name: setMinEntries
methods.desc:
AR-C: the seller sets the minimum number of entries needed for the raffle to be drawn.
Only before anyone has entered, and before the end. Below the minimum the raffle fails:
the prize returns to the seller and every entrant is refunded.

methods.name: clearWeightsBoxes
methods.desc:
Removes the totals box once every entry is refunded (the refunds remove the weights boxes
themselves) and returns its storage to whoever funded the raffle. Returns the amount released.

methods.name: gatedEnter
methods.desc:
Gated entry (principal ABI, spec §6.8): the gate subject is the verified context of the
entrant's `wallet` hint (0 = acting as itself). A plugin passes `windowHint(wallet)`.
Entries stay keyed by `Txn.sender`.

methods.name: gatedEnter
methods.desc: LEGACY shim of `gatedEnter(appl,pay,address)void` (registry gate subject; delete in Phase 4).

methods.name: gatedEnterAsa
methods.desc: LEGACY shim of `gatedEnterAsa(appl,pay,axfer,address)void` (registry gate subject; delete in Phase 4).

methods.name: gatedAdd
methods.desc: LEGACY shim of `gatedAdd(appl,pay)void` (registry gate subject; delete in Phase 4).

methods.name: gatedAddAsa
methods.desc: LEGACY shim of `gatedAddAsa(appl,axfer)void` (registry gate subject; delete in Phase 4).

methods.name: raffle
methods.desc:
Draw, commit-reveal (AR-01):
- first call after the end settles degenerate raffles (AR-07 / AR-C) or commits to a
  beacon-stored round at least DRAW_DELAY_ROUNDS ahead, whose output nobody can know yet
- a later call (BEACON_LAG_ROUNDS after that round) draws the ticket
- an empty beacon read reverts, so nobody can move the commitment (TRADE-3); only after
  BEACON_MAX_WAIT_ROUNDS does it re-commit forward, never to an already-public round

returns.desc: a boolean of whether the auction is live

methods.name: optin

args.name: asset
args.desc: The asset to be opted into

methods.desc: optin tells the contract to opt into an asa

ticketAsset.desc: The asset required to enter the raffle

startTimestamp.desc: The start round of the raffle as a unix timestamp

endTimestamp.desc: The end time of the raffle as a unix timestamp

minTickets.desc: The minimum number of tickets to use for the raffle

maxTickets.desc: The maximum number of tickets users can enter the raffle with

entryCount.desc: The number of entries for the raffle

ticketCount.desc: The number of tickets entered into the raffle

winner.desc: the winning address of the raffle

prize.desc: the prize for the raffle if prizeBox is true prize represents the app id of the prize box, otherwise the asset being raffled

isPrizeBox.desc: whether or not the prize is an asset or a prize box

prizeClaimed.desc: Indicator for whether the prize has been claimed

creatorRoyalty.desc: the amount the creator will get for the sale

gateID.desc: the gate to use for the raffle

marketplace.desc: the address of the creation side marketplace

marketplaceRoyalties.desc: the amount the marketplaces will get for the sale

akitaRoyalty.desc: the minimum impact tax for the raffle

vrfFailureCount.desc: counter for how many times we've failed to get rng from the beacon

entryID.desc: The id's of the raffle entries

weightsBoxCount.desc: the number of weights boxes that exist: one per `ChunkSize` entries not refunded yet

findWinnerCursors.desc:
cursors to track iteration of finding winner
index being for the bid iteration
amountIndex being the index for the amount of the bids seen

refundMBRCursor.desc: cursor to track iteration of MBR refunds

salt.desc: the transaction id of the create application call for salting our VRF call

raffleRound.desc: the future round committed to by the first post-end raffle() call, used for VRF (AR-01)

minEntries.desc: AR-C: minimum number of entries for the raffle to be drawn (below it the raffle fails)

failed.desc:
AR-07 / AR-C: the raffle did not reach minimum participation (or sold no tickets).
The prize returns to the seller and every entrant is refunded their tickets.

sellerReferrer.desc:
Referrer of the seller's verified wallet, resolved once by the factory at creation (zero if
none) and paid at settlement (spec §6.8). Plugins read its EXISTENCE as the marker of this
child's principal ABI; children created before it keep their own semantics until they settle.

akitaDAOEscrow.desc: the named DAO escrow this contract routes fees to (name + app)

version.desc: the current version of the contract

akitaDAO.desc: the app ID of the Akita DAO

weightTotals.desc: the ticket total of every weights box, 8 bytes each: the skip list of the winner search

weights.desc:
Ticket counts: entry `loc` owns the 8-byte slot `loc % ChunkSize` of box `loc / ChunkSize`. A
box is as long as the entries it holds: it is created by its first entry, grows one slot per
entry and shrinks again as `refundMBR` returns each entry's storage.

entriesByAddress.desc: The address map of entries for the raffle
